2026-08-04 WHOOSH SAND, root cause (his ear v6): at the CUT MOMENT the sidechain ducks the bed while the whoosh plays on top - so the whoosh IS louder than the music exactly there, even when its average RMS sits 6dB under. SECOND normalize-up trap found the same minute: sfxgen scaled the whole track to 0.72 peak, so quieter whooshes BOOSTED the impacts +2.3dB (TP +2.4 regression) - placement gains ARE the design, peak-scale down only, same rule as foley.

2026-08-05 SILENT INHERITANCE — the architecture lesson, and the real answer to 'do we split editing styles?'. The split axis is NOT the pillar (4) but the FAMILY (2): PILLAR-PROFILES.json already declared family=short_music_led (car_cinematic, travel_vlog) vs long_speech_led (car_review, industry), and NO CODE HAD EVER READ IT. car_cinematic and travel_vlog run the SAME algorithm with different NUMBERS; only speech-led needs a second editor (transcript spine). The danger was never the styles clashing - it was that the CAR style was hardcoded as the invisible default, so a new pillar inherited it in silence. Three measured leaks: clipqc's night band 18-90 REJECTS daylight footage (measured 142-165 -> 'regenerate, 22.5cr'); engine laid a whoosh/impact on EVERY cut with no pillar check; planqc 19 was scoped `!= car_cinematic` so a vlog could reach SPEND with no sound decision at all. Fixed: every pillar declares a style block (brightness_band + source, edit_sfx, sound_gate, cut_spine, card_style), clipqc/engine/planqc read it, and planqc 26 BLOCKS any pillar declaring none. GENERAL RULE: the first pillar's taste must never become the second pillar's default - style is declared, never inherited.

2026-08-05 CRAFT vs SIGNATURE (the hybrid question, answered by stage audit): of engine's 12 stages, 9 are CRAFT and transfer to any music-led pillar UNCHANGED - window allocator (non-overlapping, ban spans, action-centering, resolved-motion preference), shot-match, adjacency/coverage, bed segment scan, fitted grid phase, beat lock, sound-engineer layer calibration, master chain (HP30/limiter/LUFS/TP), and every verify gate. 2 are already plan-parameterized (grade, cards). Exactly ONE is car SIGNATURE and must switch off: edit-sfx (whoosh/impact/sub-drop on cuts) - plus the hero-foley doctrine inside check 19, now gated to sound_gate=diegetic. So the vlog HYBRID is not a compromise, it is ~90% of the system: the vlog inherits all the craft and none of the taste. Beat-locked cutting in particular is a genuine skill transfer - travel_vlog is music-led too, it just runs at 95-115 BPM instead of 140-165. PROVISIONAL values must announce themselves (26b) so a guessed number is never mistaken for a measured one.

2026-08-05 WRONG-GENRE BED, the worst find of the day (predicted then PROVEN before any vlog existed): find_bed's last resort globbed assets/bgm/**/*.wav and picked the LARGEST file. A travel_vlog plan at 105 BPM resolved to the WRX's bed_skrrt_slide_150.wav - 150 BPM phonk - and the build would have printed SUCCESS. Every downstream gate would then have measured a beat-locked, correctly-mastered video that was a car soundtrack under holiday footage; only an ear would have caught it. TWO fixes: (1) find_bed is PILLAR-AWARE - projects/<name>/audio, then BGM/<pillar>/, then assets/bgm/*<BPM>*; the catch-all glob is DELETED on purpose, because no bed fails loudly while a wrong bed ships. (2) NEW verify_bed_tempo gate: the chosen bed's tempo is MEASURED and compared to the plan (2% tol, half/double-time accepted as the same grid) and the build REFUSES on mismatch. Verified: the WRX bed measures 149.8 -> BUILD at plan 150, REFUSE at plan 105 (43% off), BUILD at plan 75 (0.5x). It also independently re-confirmed yesterday's asetrate stretch was accurate.

2026-08-05 MOTION FLOOR IS GENRE TASTE (predicted, then measured, before any vlog clip was generated): clipqc's delivered-window floor of 1.5 was tuned on car footage - launches, spray, tracking moves. So a legitimate SERENE travel shot would have been REJECTED as a dead clip at 22.5cr each. In a travel vlog a calm hold IS content; in a car edit it is a failure. motion_floor + event_motion_floor now live in the style block (car 1.5/4.0 MEASURED, vlog 0.6/2.5 PROVISIONAL from synthetic tests). Verified both directions: the serene clip passes as travel_vlog and still fails as car_cinematic. GENERAL RULE for every threshold in the codebase: ask whether it encodes PHYSICS (keep it global) or TASTE (move it to the style block) - 1.5 looked like physics and was taste.

2026-08-05 BED USABILITY IS A REACH TEST, NOT A MEMBERSHIP TEST. First reading of the travel_vlog bank asked 'is the native tempo inside 95-115?' and scored 3/19. The correct question is 'can it REACH the band within the +-8% stretch the WRX proved safe (Skrrt Slide +7.73% asetrate, on-genre)?' - which makes the real acceptance window native 88-124 and scores the SAME bank 14/19. Nearly five times the yield from re-reading the rule, zero extra downloads. The plan's BPM is then set to the CHOSEN bed (7 of the 14 need zero stretch), never the reverse. Generalises: before sourcing more material, check whether the FILTER is wrong.

2026-08-08 THE DUPLICATE SCENES WERE THE EDITOR'S FAULT, NOT THE GENERATOR'S - HIS CALL, AND MEASUREMENT SPLIT IT IN TWO. SEARCHING EVERY NON-OVERLAPPING WINDOW PAIR OF EACH DUPLICATED SOURCE FOR THE MOST DIFFERENT PAIR AVAILABLE: source C could have delivered composition 0.817 colour 0.798 and the allocator chose 0.928/0.986 - the editor threw away a clean option. 2026-08-08 A LIMITER THAT SILENTLY EATS HALF THE CORRECTION IS A LIE. HIS CATCH: 'the bgm is slightly louder than everything it covers all the sfx, and foley which is not balanced'. Root cause found in engine.py: FOL_DB = max(-8.0, min(8.0, want)). The mixer measured foley at -22.5dB against a -6.2dB target, computed the correct +16.3dB, applied the +8.0dB the clamp allows, and printed 'trim +8.0dB' as though it had succeeded. Foley shipped 8.3dB under its own target. A comment directly above the clamp quotes him from an EARLIER session saying the bgm was so loud you cannot hear Nev - the calibration was built for exactly this and the clamp defeats it every time, because Seedance ambience is always this quiet. MITIGATION: When a computed correction is clamped, report the SHORTFALL and treat it as a failure, never print the clamped value as the result. engine.py now names the gap and says where the real fix is: the clip audio is too quiet to lift by gain alone, so fix it at the source - louder generate_audio, or normalise the foley stem before mixing - and do NOT widen the clamp.

2026-08-08 A CUT IS A CHANGE OF PLACE AND THE SOUND MUST KNOW IT HAPPENED. MEASURED ON DESAFARM: median spectral similarity across the 19 cuts was 0.935, against 0.947 at random mid-shot control points. Cutting from a goat pen to a car interior changed the soundscape no more than a random moment inside a single shot did. Every audio gate passed - check 8 measures loudness, check 3 measures the transient at a cut, and neither asks whether the WORLD sounds different on the other side of the cut. MITIGATION: verify 16 soundscape: the median spectral similarity across cuts must sit at least 0.03 BELOW the median at random mid-shot points. If it does not, the bed is carrying the film and the foley is inaudible whatever the mixer's log claims it applied. Self-calibrating against the film's own mid-shot control rather than an absolute constant.

2026-08-08 THE CAR WAS DRIVING AT 90 DEGREES TO ITS OWN ROAD AND I LOOKED AT THE SHOT TWICE WITHOUT SEEING IT. The frame shows a SIDE window - the wing mirror proves it - with the road receding straight away into the distance, which only happens through a WINDSCREEN. There is also no steering wheel anywhere in frame although the prompt asked for one hand on the wheel, and the view barely moves across three seconds, so it is a parked plate rather than a drive. I had looked at that shot twice: once to reject it as a silhouette and once to confirm my own reshoot had fixed the exposure. MITIGATION: Interior and vehicle prompts must name the window they shoot through AND what the view does through it - a SIDE window sweeps the landscape across frame, a WINDSCREEN recedes - plus the controls that must be visible. Auditing your own repair is how a 90-degree error survives two inspections.

2026-08-08 HE PERFORMED INTO SILENCE AND THE ONLY THING I HAD NOTICED WAS A VERIFY LINE ABOUT THE HERO SFX. HIS CATCH ON DESAFARM: 'nevs expression have no sfx or other elements to back it up'. Measured on the delivered mix as a voice-band to low-band energy ratio: 0.25 on the shot where he laughs out loud, 0.16 on the shot where he is shocked - against 0.19 on a control shot of EMPTY HILLS with nobody in it. The shocked shot carries less vocal-band energy than a landscape. I had read verify check 3 saying the hero transient was +0.4dB and filed it as a mix note, and never asked the obvious question: is there a laugh under the laugh. MITIGATION: Any shot whose PURPOSE is a human performance must be gated on carrying human sound. Measure the voice band against a no-person control shot from the same film; a performance shot at or below the control has no audio behind the face. FOLEY entries for performance shots are a requirement of the plan, not a nicety, and the hero moment for a reaction is the VOICE, not an edit whoosh.

2026-08-08 THE FINAL SCORECARD WAS SCORING A FILM IT COULD NOT SEE. TOOLS/MASTERMIND.PY REPORTED SHOT_COUNT = 1 FOR A TWENTY SHOT FILM, WHICH IS THE INPUT ITS 'SHOT VARIETY' SEAT SCORES. CAUSE: it detected cuts as a Bhattacharyya distance > 0.45 between GREYSCALE 64-bin histograms, and desafarm is graded consistently with half the frame green pasture, so not one of the 19 cuts cleared the threshold. It then failed shot variety for the wrong reason and reported sharpness_min 9.0 - which was the middle of the DECLARED whip, a transition doing its job, scored as a melted frame. It reached the right verdict, SEND BACK, on broken inputs. MITIGATION: A gate with a broken input is lying even when its verdict is right. mastermind now takes the ENGINE'S OWN cut manifest when it exists - the engine wrote the film, it knows where the cuts are - and falls back to mean absolute frame difference with an adaptive threshold, which found 14 boundaries where the histogram found none. Sharpness is measured AWAY from cuts with blur AT cuts reported separately, so a transition can never be mistaken for a soft shot. Audit every QC input the same way: check the tool sees what you see before trusting what it says.

2026-08-08 THE FLINCH IS THE INSTRUMENT AND I WAS ASKING HIM TO JUSTIFY IT BEFORE USING IT. ASKED HOW HE FINDS DEFECTS HE SAID: 'usually i know the moment it happens, and then i have a feeling even if there is nothing wrong with the video, but i have the feeling or the urge when i see this video is not right or it's a little bit weird, then i will directly tell you. i would not go and find it somewhere else.' The car at 90 degrees to its road took him half a second to FEEL and a sentence to explain - and the sentence is the part the pipeline could have produced itself. The half-second is the part it cannot produce at all, and it is the same half-second the audience gets. So a vague note is worth MORE than a precise one: a precise note describes one shot, a vague one says something is wrong in a place nobody has thought to look. That is how all eight relationship pairs were found. MITIGATION: tools/flinch.py <project> <seconds>. He supplies the flinch and the timestamp, the pipeline supplies the microscope: which shot and source, position within the shot, luma against the film's range, sharpness, motion at that instant, sound level and voice-band content, soundscape change across the nearest cut, beat offset, duplicate match against every other shot, and which cards are up. NEVER ask him to justify a reaction before acting on it. If nothing measured explains the feeling, THAT IS THE FINDING - build the instrument that would have seen it.

2026-08-11 IDENTITY REFERENCES WERE SCENE-BLIND: EVERY HUMAN SHOT GOT THE SAME THREE FACES NO MATTER WHERE THE CAMERA STOOD. An over-the-shoulder cabin shot was handed three FRONT faces and no back of head; a shot from close behind got no back reference at all. The library was never the problem: assets/nev/ holds 97 measured images (6-frame face turnaround, closeups, 11 wardrobe sets front/profile/back, all catalogued in index.json) and the plan simply never chose from it - PLATES carried one blanket identity_refs list and every source inherited it. THE FIX: plans declare SOURCE_REFS = {source: [1-3 refs]} chosen for THAT scene's facing, framing and state (a soaked-dark shirt gets NO crisp white wardrobe ref), planqc 27b blocks a plan whose human sources have no entry, whose sets are all identical (the blanket renamed), or whose from-behind shots carry no back reference; PRODUCTION.md prints each scene's chosen refs under its verbatim prompt and the storyboard draws the scene's own refs, not the plate's. THE SHAPE, again: a spec that lives in ONE place (the plate) and is inherited everywhere is the wardrobe-declaration bug and the shot_match_clamp bug wearing a third coat - selection must live where the variation lives, at the SOURCE.

2026-08-11 THE OUTPUT FILTER IS A PIPELINE DEPENDENCY, AND IT CAN FAIL ACCOUNT-WIDE. Seven consecutive seedance video jobs came back status=nsfw on panborneo - and the isolation matrix cleared every variable we control: verbatim prompt, softened prompt, reframed composition, a different shot, NO reference image at all, the other model (2_5), and generate_audio off. A plain green SUV on an empty road with no reference was 'nsfw'. Meanwhile all four 4k PLATES passed clean, and his own manual web-UI generation with an unrelated prompt was flagged the same minute - account-wide, platform-side. WHAT SAVED THE BUILD: the probe-first protocol. One clip at a time meant seven REFUNDED failures (balance measured 4,278.82 = plates only) instead of a 292.5cr batch dying at once - and the isolation only cost polling time because failures refund. THE RULES THIS FILES: (1) when generations fail, vary ONE axis per attempt and include a BLANK CONTROL (no refs, bland prompt) before blaming the plan - five wording rewrites would have taught nothing; (2) a moderation verdict on a benign control is a PLATFORM incident: stop, record job IDs, report, retry later - never keep rewriting prompts at a filter that is not reading them; (3) hard rule 5 (five failures, stop and ask) held twice and both stops produced the next correct move.

2026-08-11 A SCRIPT THAT STASHES UNTRACKED FILES CAN STASH ITSELF, AND A BATCH FILE DIES THE MOMENT ITS OWN FILE LEAVES THE DISK. FINISH.bat step 2 ran `git stash push -u` with no excludes; FINISH.bat and talyx-FINISH.bundle were themselves untracked files sitting in the repo root, so the backup step swallowed the running script and its own payload. cmd.exe reads .bat files LINE BY LINE FROM DISK, so execution stopped right there - no error, no banner, the file just vanished from the folder. Gavril ran it at 20:17 and reported only 'I don't see the FINISH' - the evidence was the stash reflog (a second 'pre-finish-backup' entry at 1786450625) against a HEAD that never moved. TWO FIXES, both applied: stash with pathspec excludes for the script and its payload (`git stash push -u -- . ":(exclude)FINISH.bat" ":(exclude)talyx-FINISH.bundle"`), and TRACK the script in the repo so -u can never take it again. THE RULE: any self-executing file that manipulates the working tree must first ask what its own operations do to ITS OWN FILE - same class as the build that timed out before its atomic write.

2026-08-12 'PREVIEW-GRADE' IS A GATE BYPASS WITH A POLITE NAME. The panborneo preview cut skipped mastermind QC + verify because it was 'only a preview' — and shipped to Gavril's eye with FIVE defects he caught in one viewing (no BGM, no transitions, split-window duplicates, inaudible foley, double-encode softness). 2026-08-12 GAVRIL'S BINDING EDIT RULE: ONE SCENE PER SOURCE CLIP. Never split one 5s generated clip into two windows and place them at different points in the cut — the audience reads the repeated setting as a duplicate ('this will make it look so weird'). SHOT_WINDOW picks the single best window per clip; the rest of the clip is unused coverage, not free footage. The v1 preview used 20 shots from 13 clips and he caught every doubled source instantly.

2026-08-12 MIX LEVELS ARE RELATIVE TO THE FULL STACK — SHIPPING A PARTIAL STACK AT FINAL LEVELS DELETES A LAYER TO THE EAR. v1/v2 applied per-shot FOLEY attenuation (-3..-9dB) designed to sit UNDER a bed, then shipped with NO bed: measured shot RMS -26..-42dB = inaudible on a phone. Gavril heard it as 'all the videos already have their own sound effect... you cut them all.' The clip audio was present — and that distinction does not matter, because inaudible IS cut. If a layer is absent, RE-SOLVE the balance for the layers actually present.
